message.content:
This document is a technical README and set of engineering notes for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash). Key technical points:

**Architecture & Models**
- Supports GLM-5.3-Flash (320B params, 18B active, 45 layers, 288 experts top-8, KDA linear attention + DSA/MLA sparse attention, mHC residuals, MTP), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
